title: Add JMAP WebPush VAPID note to Push Notifications section
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Push Notifications section: add a note that servers supporting RFC 8620 push subscriptions SHOULD also advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:webpush-vapid (draft-ietf-jmap-webpush-vapid-10) and authenticate their Web Push messages with a VAPID-signed JWT. This is critical for mobile JMAP Chat clients.
